craft_notes: Sthāyin: gate-keeping. Sanskrit-first: yathā-yathā/tathā-tathā ladder kept. Rows: 2. Close: ripeness certain. Rejected: softening na-anyathā — killed: the bar is the verse. Read aloud: measuring cadence.

lines: the short road yields to ripeness certain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā yathā ca svabhyastajñānastanmayatātmakaḥ | gurustathā tathā kuryāt saṃkṣiptaṃ karma nānyathā
